title: Australian Aircrew Lost Over Europe
memorial_details:
Erect stone with emblem of the RAAF on a tablet and underneath a dedicatory plaque on the 6 o'clock face. On the 12 o'clock face a smaller plaque.

Unveiled by Group Captain Roxley McNellan, Air Force Adviser of the Australian High Commission, London on 16th May 1995.
inscription: 6 o'clock face: THIS REMEMBRANCE STONE/ AND THE AUSTRALIAN MEMORIAL GARDEN AND HOUSE/ ARE DEDICATED TO THE MEMORY OF/ THE 5397 AUSTRALIAN AIR CREW/ LOST IN ACTION OVER EUROPE DURING/ THE SECOND WORLD WAR 1939-1945/ UNVEILED BY/ GROUP CAPTAIN ROXLEY MCLENNAN, AIR FORCE ADVISER/ AUSTRALIAN HIGH COMMISSION, LONDON/ ON 16TH MAY 1995/ ON THIS FORMER FESTIVAL OF BRITAIN SITE 12 o'clock face: THIS MEMORIAL STONE WAS DONATED BY JOAN (...) BANNENBERG/ A NIECE OF THE LATE SQUADRON LEADER, B. A. GRACE (...), DFC, RAAF
community_connection: Donated by Joan (...) Bannenberg, a niece of the late Squadron Leader, B.A. Grace (DFC), RAAF.
